question: Does a rule-by-rule reader agree with TREC expert verdicts on the 2022 top 25, and what is its honest fabrication rate?
why_this_cutoff: The cutoff that replicated on a pre-registered 2021 test. The reader reads what the default ranker surfaced.
not_2021: 60 of 75 2021 patients are in the adapter train set.
retry_policy: Empty-quote met/not_met is coerced to not_enough_information and counted, not retried. One targeted repair remains for broken JSON or leftover schema errors; it names only the failed rule_ids and does not paste the previous reply. Omitted rules are filled as not_enough_information. Raw model text is stored every time.
quote_guardrail: If a quote is offered, it must exist in the named source. verify_quote.py is unchanged. That is not the same rule as requiring every met/not_met to carry a quote.
silence_is_nei: CONTEXT.md: a filter may only eliminate on confident evidence; silence is a pass. not_met requires a span. A silent note is not_enough_information.

probe_13_of_50_diagnosis.not_accuracy: 13 of 50 is schema-conformance on the first probe, not agreement with TREC labels.
probe_13_of_50_diagnosis.guardrail: The quote-exists-in-source check rejected nothing that had a span. The 37 trial failures were the output contract, not the fabrication guardrail.
probe_13_of_50_diagnosis.not_max_new: No stored failure sat at or near 2048 output tokens. Longest failure was 1390 tokens. A 45-rule trial passed; a 2-rule trial failed.
probe_13_of_50_diagnosis.retries_were_waste: All 37 used three greedy retries. The retry pasted the previous JSON, so the same empty quotes came back.
probe_13_of_50_diagnosis.fix: Prompt matches CONTEXT.md silence-is-pass. Coerce leftover empty-quote met/not_met to NEI and count it. Targeted repair only for JSON or leftover schema. Quote verifier unchanged. No batching. No vLLM.

rule_split: Programmatic. Inclusion/exclusion headers, then bullets or paragraphs. The model does not invent the rule list.

splitter_audit_before_scores.calib_NCT01160822: line_header, 33 rules (9 inclusion / 24 exclusion). Overview said 9 + 20.
splitter_audit_before_scores.decision: no_header is 4%. The mixed-polarity subset is 5 trials (0.4%). Note in the write-up and run.

aggregation.any_hard_fail: Excluded if any exclusion rule is met or any inclusion rule is not_met. Joinable only if every inclusion is met, no exclusion fires, and nothing is unsettled. Otherwise uncertain.
aggregation.net_balance: Excluded if any exclusion fires, or if fewer than half of the settled inclusions are met. Joinable if at least half of settled inclusions are met and nothing is unsettled. Otherwise uncertain.
aggregation.compatible_unless_contradicted: TREC assessors' rule. Excluded if an exclusion fires or an inclusion is positively failed. Otherwise compatible. Unsettled rules get no vote.
aggregation.unsplit: u_not is a contradiction; u_met is a confirmation. Same as any_hard_fail / net_balance.
aggregation.score_compatible: Contradiction: min(0.05 * confirms/n / contradictions, 0.05). No contradiction: 0.50 + 0.50 * confirms/n. confirms = inc_met + exc_not + u_met. contradictions = exc_met + inc_not + u_not.

quote_buckets.ok: Exact or whitespace-normalised span in the named source
quote_buckets.A: Stitched from two or more real spans
quote_buckets.C: In the trial text, but not about this rule
quote_buckets.D: Paraphrase (high in-order word overlap, not a span)

fabrication: D + E. Report raw flag rate, bucket shares, and D+E separately. Earlier work treated above 5% as a support problem and measured 1.3%. Not a new gate.
measures: Agreement with TREC labels 2/1/0 under both aggregation rules
Joinable-versus-excluded AUROC on the same 1-versus-2 basis as 0.779
Raw quote-flag rate, bucket breakdown, honest fabrication rate
Cost and a 50-to-100 row sample for Will to hand-check
rules_note: TREC 2022 top-25 criteria split into 13.2 rules per trial, not the ~43 figure from the lung-cancer reader. Cost should land under the $7–15 sketch if generation time scales with output length.
note: These eleven-plus runs are the ones that produce reported results, not every experiment the project has run. A probe on patients 1 and 2 is scored first. Stop and ask if the projection heads past about $25. The system does not say a patient qualifies.
